_comment: 1.12.2 line against legacy Just Enough Items 4.16.x. No 'Registering JEI pinyin search index' check here: that line is emitted by JechJeiPlugin.registerAdvancedSearch, and legacy JEI 4.16.1.301 has no mezz/jei/api/IAdvancedSearchRegistry to implement (75 classes under mezz/jei/api, none of them the search API; HEI 4.34.0 has it). With legacy JEI the integration is the classic ASM path instead — its two markers below are the assertion, and the extra check pins the suffix-tree patch only this path applies. Declared `skip` on 2026-10-14: the 1.12.2 client cannot boot in this checkout's Gradle dev run on this arm64 machine (LWJGL 2's macOS natives are x86_64/i386-only, the only JDK 8 here is arm64), and the instance launcher whose arm64 natives substitution made the row green is retired — measured, with the probe log and the native architectures, in envs/README.md `The 1.12.2 rows and the gradle backend`. The checks stay as written.
